Get More Done with Compact Strength.

Comfortable, Capable, and Built for Hard Work.

The 2024 KIOTI DK4520 is a powerful and versatile utility tractor designed for landowners, farmers, and contractors who need reliable performance with operator-friendly design. Featuring a 45 HP KIOTI diesel engine, hydrostatic or manual transmission options, and a robust 3-point hitch, the DK4520 handles everything from mowing and digging to hauling and grading.

With easy-to-use controls, power steering, and durable construction, the DK4520 is ready for work—big or small.

Features may include:

Proven KIOTI Diesel Power
45 HP 3-cylinder KIOTI engine offers strong low-end torque and fuel-efficient operation.

Transmission Options
Choose from manual shuttle or hydrostatic transmission (DK4520H) for the driving experience that suits your needs.

3-Point Hitch Strength
Category I/II hitch with 2,716 lbs of lift capacity—ready for loaders, blades, cutters, and more.

Independent Rear PTO
540 RPM PTO with simple engagement for running mowers, post hole diggers, and other implements.

ROPS Operator Station
Spacious, open platform with foldable ROPS provides comfort and safety with easy access to controls.

Power Steering & 4WD
Standard features ensure control and traction even in rough terrain or heavy-load conditions.
